namespace PubDC20

def promiseStep (promised req : Nat) : Nat := Nat.max promised req

theorem ballot_never_decreases (promised req : Nat) :
    promiseStep promised req ≥ promised ∧ promiseStep promised req ≥ req := by
  unfold promiseStep
  simp only [Nat.max_def]
  split <;> omega
